headline: Spain Election Odds Favor Feijóo as Minister Faces Parliament
summary: Traders put Feijóo's odds at 84% to become Spain's prime minister ahead of the November 29 vote, while Transport Minister Puente testifies before Congress.
why: Political leadership shifts in major Eurozone economies affect fiscal policy trajectories, regulatory environments, and sovereign bond yields.
